objective: Verify that Rating behaves and looks like a rating filter with clear threshold semantics.
preconditions: Rating supports text, icon, and icon plus text display modes.
Rating can choose an Elementor icon or default star symbol.
A fixture listing contains numeric rating values.
steps: Render Rating in icon plus text mode.
Select 4+ and confirm items with rating 4 and 5 remain.
expected_result: Rating is visually recognizable and its greater-than-or-equal behavior is clear.
pass_criteria: star/icon display is not a generic radio pill.
selected and unselected colors are controllable.
threshold behavior is clear in labels or editor copy.
clear behavior does not require resetting all filters.
